The meeting will host our fall picnic on **Sunday, October 4th** following worship. A barbecue is planned, so hopefully we'll have beautiful fall weather that day.

If possible, please plan to bring a salad, side dish, or dessert to share.

**Location:**
[225 Watchung Ave Plainfield, NJ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VutTE3G3TwLKkwvp9)

We hope you'll join us on October 4th! Feel free to bring a friend, too. All are welcome! We look forward to seeing you there!
